topic.title: Configuration Guide
topic.shortdesc: This guide explains how to configure and activate the Z1 Encryption Server after installation.

section.title: Accessing the Configuration Interface
section.p: After the installation, open your web browser and access the Z1 Administration Interface using the following URL:
Log in with your administrator credentials created during setup. If you are accessing the interface remotely, ensure that port 8443 is open in your firewall.

section.title: Setting Up Encryption Keys
section.p: Encryption keys are essential for securing communication. Follow these steps to generate and store your keys:

ol.li: In the Administration Interface, navigate to Security → Key Management.
Click Generate New Key and choose the key type (RSA or ECC).
Select the key length (2048 or 4096 bits) and assign a descriptive name.
Click Save to store the key securely in the local keystore.

section.title: Connecting to the Directory Service
section.p: To enable automatic certificate lookup and user management, integrate Z1 with your directory service:

ol.li: Select your service type: Active Directory or LDAP.
Enter the server address, port number, and authentication credentials.
Click Test Connection to verify connectivity.
